$schema: night-line color tokens — single source of truth for GDD §14 (Look and feel)

baseNight.use: background canvas / sky base — the near-black darkness the rest of the palette lights up against

carBody.use: player car body and wheel silhouette (car/body.svg) — neutral, non-light-emitting

rearLightRed.use: player car rear lights layer only (car/rear-lights.svg) — pulses independently of the body

headlightGlow.use: headlight cone gradient — warm outer falloff stop, fades to transparent (car/headlight-cone.svg)

anchorDormant.use: anchor post outside its throw window — cool cyan, must never read as a hazard (anchor/post.svg)

anchorOpen.use: anchor post while the throw window is open — the brightest object after the headlight cone (anchor/post-open.svg)

obstacleWarning.use: reserved exclusively for obstacle silhouettes (obstacle/*.svg) and the low-power meter warning pulse

pickupPower.use: headlight-power pickup anchor variant (anchor/pickup-power.svg) — distinct from anchorDormant/Open and obstacleWarning

pickupHighBeam.use: high-beam pickup anchor variant (anchor/pickup-highbeam.svg) — distinct from pickupPower and the anchor cyans

roadShoulder.use: shoulder / edge strip either side of the road surface

laneMarking.use: lane divider dashes on the road surface

reflectorUnlit.use: unlit scenery reflector post (road/reflector-post.svg) — the 1976 lineage marker, dimmer than any anchor
